state_spaces.name: participation_space
state_spaces.definition: Domain of non-null activation or participation conditions such as E_alpha > 0.

state_spaces.name: constraint_memory_space
state_spaces.definition: Domain of residue inscription, persistence, and accumulated constraint history.

state_spaces.name: orientation_space
state_spaces.definition: Domain of process-relative admissibility orientation, including -(i). Not a primitive spatial container.

state_spaces.name: topological_constraint_space
state_spaces.definition: Domain of boundary, connectivity, and constraint topology written by continuation.

state_spaces.name: transition_space
state_spaces.definition: Domain of admissible update pressures and transformation conditions.

state_spaces.name: constraint_geometry_space
state_spaces.definition: Emergent structural domain generated by participation, residue, admissibility, topology, and transition legality. Not a primitive manifold substrate.

legal_chains.name: orientation_to_transition_chain
legal_chains.description: Orientation selection may produce admissible transition pressure only through navigation, admissibility projection, and gating.

legal_chains.name: residue_update_chain
legal_chains.description: Admissible transition conditions may inscribe or modify residue through Psi.

legal_chains.name: projection_chain
legal_chains.description: Transitions may become observables only through projection operators.

projection_hierarchy.meaning: Observables depend on projection, and projection depends on constrained continuation.

pipeline_stages.purpose: Filter candidate continuation through admissibility conditions.
Update admissibility topology and geometry stability.
Evaluate admissible inverse reconstruction from observables.
Assign governance, evidence, and legality status.

ontology_class_requirement.statement: Every canonical term must declare exactly one ontology_class.

operator_state_space_requirement.statement: Every operator_signature should declare source_space, target_space, and whether the transformation is direct, projected, or residue-mediated.

admissible_continuation_rule_v1.name: admissible_continuation_rule_v1
admissible_continuation_rule_v1.form: x_alpha_prime is admissible iff gate_A(Pi_A(NavT(omega_alpha, omega_beta)), R) passes
admissible_continuation_rule_v1.process_rewrite: A continuation may update only when orientation navigation, admissibility projection, and residue context jointly permit the transition.
admissible_continuation_rule_v1.forbidden_reading: Logical equivalence, static permission, or external law imposed from outside process.

admissibility_closure_rule_v1.name: admissibility_closure_rule_v1
admissibility_closure_rule_v1.statement: A transformation chain is valid only if each successive operator accepts the ontology class and state space produced by the previous operator.

projection_dependence_rule_v1.name: projection_dependence_rule_v1
projection_dependence_rule_v1.statement: An observable may emerge only through a valid projection chain from admissible continuation.

resolution_dependence_rule_v1.name: resolution_dependence_rule_v1
resolution_dependence_rule_v1.statement: Different projection resolutions may produce different observable structures from the same constrained continuation process.
resolution_dependence_rule_v1.process_rewrite: Observable distinction depends on admissibility-filtered projection scale and orientation context.

process_chain_composition_rule_v1.name: process_chain_composition_rule_v1
process_chain_composition_rule_v1.statement: A process chain is valid only if each successive transformation satisfies admissibility closure and state-space compatibility.

recursive_residue_accumulation_v1.name: recursive_residue_accumulation_v1
recursive_residue_accumulation_v1.statement: Residue generated by prior admissible transformations conditions future admissibility relations within the same process chain.
recursive_residue_accumulation_v1.process_rewrite: Continuation recursively reshapes the legality landscape of subsequent continuation.

chain_projection_dependence_v1.name: chain_projection_dependence_v1
chain_projection_dependence_v1.statement: Observable projections may depend on the full admissibility history of a process chain, not only the most recent transition.

constraint_geometry_generation_rule_v1.name: constraint_geometry_generation_rule_v1
constraint_geometry_generation_rule_v1.statement: Constraint Geometry is generated only through valid process-chain composition involving participation, admissibility, residue, topology, transition legality, and projection.

tripartite_law_completion_rule_v1.name: tripartite_law_completion_rule_v1
tripartite_law_completion_rule_v1.statement: Potential, residue history, and update dynamics are incomplete when isolated; a complete PCD law chain must declare how participation, residue-mediated admissibility, and transition update are coupled.

residue_geometry_deformation_v1.name: residue_geometry_deformation_v1
residue_geometry_deformation_v1.statement: Accumulated residue may deform admissibility structure by modifying future continuation legality.
residue_geometry_deformation_v1.process_rewrite: Continuation changes the geometry of future continuation.

topology_mutation_rule_v1.name: topology_mutation_rule_v1
topology_mutation_rule_v1.statement: Admissible process chains may alter topological constraint structure through recursive residue-conditioned continuation.

constraint_geometry_stability_v1.name: constraint_geometry_stability_v1
constraint_geometry_stability_v1.statement: A geometry region is stable only while recursive admissibility closure remains self-consistent under residue-conditioned continuation.

recursive_orientation_rebinding_v1.name: recursive_orientation_rebinding_v1
recursive_orientation_rebinding_v1.statement: Orientation relations may rebind under accumulated residue deformation when admissibility conditions shift.
recursive_orientation_rebinding_v1.process_rewrite: Recursive continuation may alter dominant admissibility orientation structures.

admissible_reconstruction_rule_v1.name: admissible_reconstruction_rule_v1
admissible_reconstruction_rule_v1.statement: Observable reconstruction is valid only when projection history, admissibility conditions, and residue context are sufficiently constrained.

projection_aliasing_rule_v1.name: projection_aliasing_rule_v1
projection_aliasing_rule_v1.statement: Distinct admissible continuation structures may produce equivalent observable projections at a given resolution.
projection_aliasing_rule_v1.process_rewrite: Projection equivalence does not imply process identity.

pipeline_stage_dependency_rule_v1.name: pipeline_stage_dependency_rule_v1
pipeline_stage_dependency_rule_v1.statement: No downstream pipeline stage may execute without satisfying the legality and admissibility conditions of all upstream stages.

pcd_stack_version_header_v1.name: pcd_stack_version_header_v1
pcd_stack_version_header_v1.statement: Governed PCD documents must declare the active PCD formal stack version.
